rules.title: SSL 2.0 / SSL 3.0 Obsolete Protocol
rules.description: Critical deduction for obsolete SSL protocol susceptible to trivial cryptanalysis and structural downgrade attacks (POODLE / DROWN).

rules.title: NULL Cipher / Plaintext Transport
rules.description: Critical deduction for cleartext transport or null cipher negotiation enabling passive sniffing and zero confidentiality.

rules.title: Revoked Certificate In Use
rules.description: High deduction for active use of an authoritatively revoked certificate identified via captured OCSP response.

rules.title: Plaintext Email Transport
rules.description: High deduction for observed unencrypted SMTP/IMAP/POP3 application traffic carried without a TLS transition.

rules.title: STARTTLS Advertised but Plaintext Continued
rules.description: High deduction for an email server advertising STARTTLS while the captured client session continued in unencrypted plaintext without upgrading to TLS.

rules.title: Expired X.509 Certificate
rules.description: Medium deduction for expired certificate in validation path exceeding its notAfter validity period.

rules.title: Inadequate RSA Key Size (<2048-bit)
rules.description: Medium deduction for sub-2048-bit public key modulus failing modern cryptographic safety margins.

rules.title: Certificate Chain Trust Path Failure
rules.description: Medium deduction for unanchored or broken certificate validation chain unable to reach a trusted root CA.

rules.title: RC4 Obsolete Stream Cipher
rules.description: Calibrated deduction for RC4 keystream bias vulnerabilities formally prohibited by RFC 7465.

rules.title: Legacy Signature Algorithm (MD5 / SHA-1)
rules.description: Calibrated deduction for certificate signature using deprecated hash digest algorithms susceptible to collision attacks.

rules.title: Weak Diffie-Hellman Modulus (<2048-bit)
rules.description: Calibrated deduction for weak Diffie-Hellman parameters vulnerable to discrete logarithm precomputation attacks.

rules.title: TLS 1.0 / TLS 1.1 Deprecated Protocol
rules.description: Advisory deduction for deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols prohibited by RFC 8996 and lacking modern AEAD support.

rules.title: 64-bit Block Cipher (3DES / DES)
rules.description: Advisory deduction for use of a legacy 64-bit block cipher susceptible to SWEET32 birthday collision attacks.

rules.title: CBC-Mode Cipher Suite Usage
rules.description: Advisory deduction for use of legacy CBC-mode cipher suites in TLS 1.2 subject to padding oracle risks.

rules.title: Unapproved / Unverified Cipher Suite Negotiated
rules.description: Advisory deduction for negotiating a cipher suite outside the approved NIST SP 800-52r2 baseline.

rules.title: Static RSA Key Exchange
rules.description: Advisory deduction for lack of forward secrecy allowing retrospective decryption if private keys are compromised.

rules.title: Premature / Not-Yet-Valid Certificate
rules.description: Advisory deduction for certificate observed before its notBefore timestamp, indicating possible clock skew.

rules.title: Self-Signed Certificate Presented
rules.description: Advisory deduction for self-signed certificate lacking verifiable root path from an independent authority.

rules.title: Hostname / SAN Mismatch
rules.description: Advisory deduction for mismatch between observed TLS client SNI and certificate SAN/CN identity.
